_comment: Golden SH->binaural sampling decode (WP15/D51) over a SYNTHETIC HRIR grid defined in tools/reference/gen_binaural_reference.py. Consumed by tests/XoaBinauralDecoderTests.cpp, which rebuilds the same fixture as a spatcore HrirDatabase and runs Source/DSP/AmbiBinauralDecoder. Tolerance: 1e-5 (the C++ accumulates in double and stores float).

provenance.conventions: ACN/SN3D real SH, no Condon-Shortley; grid azimuth positive to the listener's RIGHT, negated into XOA's +Y-left soundfield frame; ear 0 = LEFT; exact zone-area quadrature weights summing to 4pi; ITD restored from relDelaySec with a Blackman-windowed sinc (half-width 16)

fixture.itdFormula: maxItdSec * sin(az) * cos(el); positive -> LEFT ear later
